title: Number of digit one
statement: Count the total number of digit 1 appearing in all integers from 0 to n inclusive (n ≤ 10⁹).
hints: Build numbers digit by digit from the left, tracking whether you're still equal to n's prefix ("tight").
Or count per position: how often is the digit at 10^k equal to 1? (high, current, low parts).
complexity: O(digits × 10 × digits) DP, or O(digits) by formula

solution.explanation: Digit DP counts numbers ≤ n with a property by walking digits left to right with a tight flag: while tight, the next digit can't exceed n's digit. The state (position, tight, count so far) is tiny. The per-position formula (for each place value p: high·p + clamp(low + 1 − p… )) is faster but error-prone; the DP generalises to any digit property.
